meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 将 clidash 装进 tools/ 并生成配置文件,启动一个只读的本地网页仪表盘,显示 NanoClaw 的代理组、会话、通道、用户、角色等资源,以及消息活动图表、日志尾部和文件查看器。
howto.when: 当用户要求安装、配置或启动 clidash 仪表盘,或提到要查看 NanoClaw 资源总览时。

say.text: 请帮我安装 clidash,并在本地启动仪表盘。
say.note: 会复制工具、创建配置并运行 server.js。

say.text: 用 ncl 配置 clidash,显示代理组和会话列表。
say.note: 仪表盘会按资源生成标签页。

say.text: 给 clidash 添加 docker 资源,并运行测试。
say.note: 会修改配置并执行 npm test。

howto.what_en: Installs clidash into tools/, generates config, and starts a read-only local web dashboard showing NanoClaw's agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles, plus activity charts, log tail, and file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install, configure, or launch the clidash dashboard, or mentions viewing a NanoClaw resource overview.

say_en.text: Please install clidash and start the dashboard locally.
say_en.note: It copies tools and runs server.js.

say_en.text: Configure clidash with ncl and show agent groups and sessions.
Add docker as a resource for clidash and run the tests.
say_en.note: Updates config and runs npm test.
